body:
CHECK MAINLINE-022b and 022c complete. Seventy rows reproduce: 4,894 independent field comparisons, 33 ancillary calculations and 894 printed numbers, with zero arithmetic mismatches. Owner scripts were not run or imported.

Demonstrated source mismatch: 024 doubles total thickness for Zylon 0/90; both scans omit that factor. At the published 022c equilateral 5%/019 points, corrected film/least factors are 0.746876/0.708523, versus reported least 1.485116/1.417047. Exact differences are pinned.

Omitted modes matter. The cap projection points develop 665.740/990.543 MPa tensile bending at their reported limits, without an independent tensile limit. NASA long-strut interaction remains unqualified. The 023 sleeve/wrap sizing consumes its assumed bond/axial allowables at design force; its frozen joint multiplier is 1, absent from the six-mode minimum.

The 0.25 m radius cap is not driving the tested optima. Continuous searches widened to spacing 19.9 m/radius 1 m return the same maxima within 9e-12, inside the original bounds. Twelve film gauges limit the reported grid optima; refined witnesses are documented separately.

Sixty-three artifact and twelve PDF pins verify; 87 package checks pass. CHECK, RESULTS, INPUTS, nine-row NFI, 24 exact source/scope differences, scripts and complete manifest are pinned. Qualified system factor and compression allowable remain unknown. Objections become NFI and stop no work. No successor assigned; awaiting robotics dispatch.
